newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bremen authorities voice concern over Vulkan wharf.
newsitem.headline: Bremen authorities voice concern over Vulkan wharf.

text.p: Bremen's city council said on Friday that the Vegesack wharf ran there by the bankrupt Bremer Vulkan Verbund AG was heading for collapse if financing was not secured for the construction of two container ships.

The council said in a statement that it understood the European Commission was only willing to consider providing financial aid for the projects if the wharf was closed immediately after construction was completed.
The EC has until now refused subsidies to help with the construction of the two ships, which is currently going ahead with funds from the bankruptcy estate.
The Bremen council warned that failure to complete construction for the two ships would "not only condemn facilities at Vegesack to closure", but would also affect jobs elsewhere in the region.
Some 1,000 workers are employed at the Bremen-Vegesack wharf.
